about: Beat components for the generic Short. Use in plan.json beats: {component, props}. Any prop named `at` or ending in `At` is a script phrase (or {phrase, after, edge, offset}) and is resolved to seconds by build_plan.py. Tones: profit (green, gains/above 1x), loss (red, losses/below 1x/risks), note (yellow, disclaimers/pending), neutral (blue, labels/neutral numbers), accent (theme colour, structure only). Rich text: "plain *accent phrase*" puts one phrase in italic serif. Images: path relative to the job public/ folder.

KineticLine.use: One spoken line typed part by part, one accent phrase (hook lines, transitions).

NoteCard.use: An important point or caveat (yellow = note). Optional chips.

example.text: Day 1 subscription is only an *indication of demand*

BigNumber.use: One headline number counting up (issue size, total bids).

StackedTotal.use: Combined total with a stacked bar; each item grows as it is named (multi-IPO hook).

SplitBar.use: Parts of one whole side by side (fresh issue vs OFS).

AmountRows.use: Labelled amounts with bars (use of proceeds); rows without value show a striped 'pending' bar; optional source table image panned to its amounts column.

example.kicker: Fresh issue ka paisa kahan jayega

Bars.use: Flat bars from a baseline comparing 2 to 5 values (template F).

example.title: Of the *top 25%* funds, how many stayed there?

Calculation.use: a × b = result (lot size × upper band = minimum investment). Add a matching entry to plan.checks.

EntityCard.use: Company / fund card (redesigned X card): stats appear exactly when spoken. icon: factory | gear | radar | heart | tower | chart.

FlowExplainer.use: Two money/ownership flows compared (fresh issue vs OFS), chips per item, optional dark callout.

callout.text: OFS money goes to the selling shareholders, not the company

Checklist.use: Numbered points arriving one by one (what to check instead).

RowsReveal.use: Rows sliding in: lead label + pill + note (year-by-year leader).

Timeline.use: Key dates in order (close, allotment, listing).

DocCard.use: Report / document card with slight 3D tilt and category pills (template E).

TileDrop.use: N numbered tiles; at dropAt all but `keep` (0-based) fall away in red, kept turn green.

DotGrid.use: Grid of dots (default 100); at fadeAt all but `keep` fade, kept turn green ('only 4 of 100').

Ranking.use: A ranked list where one item (`mover`, 0-based) slides to position `to` as others pass it; optional note.

example.title: Out of the top 25% *≠ bad returns*

ImageCallout.use: Chart/table screenshot with boxes on discussed rows (source pixel coords) + value tiles.

ImageCard.use: News clipping / tweet screenshot as a clean card (reflow wide clippings first with reflow.py), optional highlighter wipe.

scenes.paper: off-white + dot grid (default ground, data explainers)
scenes.market: candles + rising line (intro, CTA, market topics)
scenes.gears: gears + wind turbines (industrial, power transmission, engineering, energy)
scenes.radar: radar sweeps + imaging band (defence, security, imaging)
scenes.medical: heartbeat line, stent mesh, plus signs (healthcare, medical devices, pharma)
scenes.telecom: skyline + lattice towers with signal arcs (telecom, internet, digital)
